shell.no_snapshot: There is no earlier snapshot to restore yet.
shell.delete_confirm: Delete this plan and its local snapshots? This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you may need it.

workspace_pages.plan_description: Add arrangements on the left and see their long-term financial impact on the right.
workspace_pages.analysis_description: Review the full result, then continue with questions and comparisons in the planning assistant.

agent_panel.title: Planning assistant
agent_panel.subtitle: Ask about the current plan
agent_panel.description: The assistant reads the current plan and uses the formal ledger for analysis and simulations. You see every change before choosing whether to apply it.
examples: What changes if I retire two years later?
Which year is tightest when housing and child costs overlap?
How much should housing costs change if I move cities?
agent_panel.placeholder: Ask about this plan or simulate a change
agent_panel.privacy_agent: With your consent, DeepSeek receives your question, plan summary, editable targets and tool results to select Skills. Calculation and writes remain local.
agent_panel.skills_description: This is the complete list. The model selects Skills in agent mode; local mode uses deterministic rules. Used Skills are marked for this question.
agent_panel.skill_consent_description: DeepSeek selects read-only or simulation Skills, up to five sequential steps. The local engine calculates all amounts; only your confirmation changes the plan.
agent_panel.skill_consent_fields: Current question, four recent messages, plan summary, key events, editable target names/IDs, this turn's Skill results, and preferences you explicitly saved. The full monthly ledger, raw asset/liability records and whole plan are excluded.
agent_panel.skill_consent_service: DeepSeek Chat Completions Tool Calls; the server configures the model. LangChain is not integrated in this prototype.
agent_panel.skill_consent_storage: This product does not save conversations on the server; the provider may retain request logs under its policy. Your browser manages local task records.
agent_panel.skill_consent_scope: Only the next question or this page session; you can disable it anytime.
agent_panel.memory_description: Only preferences you enter are saved, up to five. Delete them anytime. Model mode reads them; local mode does not send them.
agent_panel.memory_placeholder: For example: keep 12 months of emergency savings
agent_panel.memory_error: Your browser could not save the preference. Check local storage permissions and retry.
agent_panel.task_storage_error: Task progress could not be saved in this browser. Check local storage permissions.
agent_panel.privacy_strict: Strict mode never calls an external model. Deterministic code handles calculations, decisions, and change guardrails.
agent_panel.privacy_enhanced: Enhanced wording receives only the approved minimum summary. Turning it off restores strict mode for the next question.
agent_panel.running: Checking the ledger and verifying the result
agent_panel.proposal_intro: I ran this scenario through the formal ledger. Review the before-and-after result; it will not change your plan until you confirm.
agent_panel.proposal_stale: The current plan has changed. Ask again before applying this scenario.
agent_panel.applied: The plan was updated after your confirmation. You can still use the page's undo action.
agent_panel.consent_description: Deterministic code calculates and decides first, then a model rewrites a minimum summary. The model does not calculate or change your plan.
agent_panel.consent_fields: Your current question, the latest four conversation messages, and the local answer draft including amounts and years already shown in that draft. The full ledger, asset and liability details, and editable target IDs are excluded.
agent_panel.consent_service: DeepSeek Responses API; the specific model is configured on the server.
agent_panel.consent_storage: This product does not save the enhanced summary and sends store: false. The provider may still process request logs under its safety policy.
agent_panel.consent_scope: Choose the next question only or this browser-tab session. Neither option creates permanent permission.
agent_panel.consent_warning: One-time permission applies only to the next question. Session permission can be turned off at any time and strict mode resumes immediately.
agent_panel.enhancement_unavailable: The model is temporarily unavailable. This answer used local mode.
agent_panel.model_fallback_notice: The model is unavailable. Local rules handled this question instead.

trajectory.title: Shape your plan
trajectory.hint: Choose an area to add or adjust.

feedback.title: What this edit changed
feedback.unchanged: Updated. The first gap and balances are unchanged.

editor.short_hint: Positive values increase the selected amount; negative values reduce it. Leave out amounts already included in your current cash flow.
editor.plan_hint: Add the details that matter to you. You can skip any stage.
editor.age_error: Use whole ages: current 18–75, retirement later and no more than 80, end later than retirement and no more than 120.
editor.assets_hint: Available assets fund cash flow. Property and other non-liquid assets only contribute to net worth.
editor.skip_disabled: Remove the recorded amounts before skipping this stage.
editor.partner_hint: Record family support and expenses not already included in your baseline.
editor.split_hint: These amounts are part of your working-life spending total. Classification alone does not add costs; a larger total requires confirmation.
editor.additional_hint: Add items not already in your monthly totals. They are counted separately for the dates you enter.
editor.name: Item name
editor.event_error: Check the name, amount and dates: the amount cannot be zero, its absolute value must not exceed CNY 1 billion, the end cannot be earlier than the start, and all dates must be within the plan.
editor.yearly_hint: This yearly record is kept as imported; edit it through a backup for now.
editor.clear_confirm: Clear every item added on this page? Other sections and existing assets will not be changed.

flow.discard: You have changes that have not been applied. Leave and discard them?
flow.trust: In today's money · Not a guaranteed return

hints.assets: Start from your baseline. Update only what has changed.
hints.career: Plan different periods of work and income.
hints.partner: Record family support and shared expenses as separate items.
hints.child: Add birth, childcare, education and further children with their own dates.
hints.housing: Track housing income and costs, or estimate a home purchase and mortgage.
hints.investment: Allocate investment principal and set a gain or loss range shown only in the chart.
hints.parents: Record support paid to or received from your parents.
hints.retirement: How much will you need to pay yourself each month after retiring?
hints.events: Choose a starting point or use your own name. Add as many events as needed.
hints.advanced: Formal results use principal only. Set only the cost of a funding gap here.

investment.principal_basis: The formal ledger always uses principal value. Gains and losses appear only as a range on the long-term chart and do not change the first shortfall, minimum funds, or endpoint.
investment.name: Investment name
investment.range_hint: Levels are editable shortcuts, not forecasts or promised returns.
investment.available_at_start: Up to {amount} is projected to be available when this starts.
investment.error_funds: This principal exceeds the funds projected to be available at the investment start. Lower it or change the start date.
investment.error: Check the principal, return range, and dates. The lower bound cannot exceed the upper bound.

career.error: Check amounts and dates. Job periods must not overlap each other, nor may break periods. Both must end by retirement. A break may occur within a job. Existing income breakdowns must be fully classified.

hints.salary: Replaces your salary during these months. Your original income path resumes afterward.
hints.side_income: Enter net income not already in your baseline, with its own start and end dates.
hints.break: Salary is zero during these months. Existing side income continues; your original salary path resumes afterward.

career.growth_hint: Choose when your current salary grows. It stays flat after that period; enter a new salary separately when changing jobs.
career.growth_detail: Real growth is the change in purchasing power after inflation, not the nominal pay rise. Growth is derived from the annual rate during the selected period, then stays flat; it does not imply monthly pay reviews. This affects the current salary baseline only. New jobs and side income keep their own rates.
career.growth_error: Enter an annual real growth rate between -99% and 100%.
career.growth_range_error: Check the rate and dates. The end must be after the start and no later than retirement.

charts.compare_hint: Income and spending share one amount scale, so their heights are directly comparable. Asset returns are excluded, so the difference is not the change in balance.
charts.peak: Spending peaks in {year}, at {amount} for the year.
charts.balance_hint: Solid: spendable funds. Dashed: assets less debts.
charts.minimum: Lowest monthly available funds: {amount} in {year}. Lines show year-end balances.
charts.same_balances: Net worth matches available funds; one line is shown
charts.negative_hint: Below zero indicates a cash shortfall

scenarios.title: How investment volatility could affect funds
scenarios.hint: The line is the formal principal-only plan. Shading shows only the gain and loss range for configured investments.
scenarios.not_started: The investment has not started, so its range matches the principal plan.
scenarios.basis: Investment range only. All other results use principal value and are not forecasts or promises.
scenarios.empty: No investment has been added. Only the formal principal-only plan is shown.

analysis.title: Plan highlights
analysis.basis: Calculated from your inputs and fixed rules. No AI.
analysis.actions_hint: Compare before applying. These are scenarios to explore, not life advice.
analysis.cause_verified: Controlled check: removing this housing payment delays or removes the first shortfall.

housing-causes-first-gap.title: Housing costs are close to the first shortfall
housing-causes-first-gap.body: The first shortfall occurs within 12 months of a one-off housing payment. You can test a different date.

housing-child-overlap.title: Housing and child costs start close together
housing-child-overlap.body: These arrangements start within 24 months of each other. More cash may be needed during this period.

liquidity-gap.title: Positive net worth does not guarantee available cash
liquidity-gap.body: Some months have negative available funds despite positive net worth. Non-cash assets are not automatically spent.

retirement-transition-gap.title: A shortfall appears early in retirement
retirement-transition-gap.body: The first shortfall is in the first retirement year, without retirement income already active. Review self-funded spending.

retirement-spend-sensitive.title: Retirement spending strongly affects the endpoint
retirement-spend-sensitive.body: A 10% increase in retirement spending ranks among the three largest endpoint impacts. Compare different budgets.

zero-return-conservative.title: The formal plan always uses principal value
zero-return-conservative.body: At least 120 months have positive balances, but the formal ledger still excludes investment returns. Add a display range under Investments without changing gap or principal conclusions.

important-total-unclassified.title: Some expenses are still estimated as a total
important-total-unclassified.body: Totals work for planning. To understand individual categories, split existing totals rather than adding the same costs again.

baseline-sustainable.title: No shortfall under the included arrangements
baseline-sustainable.body: Each stage is filled in or explicitly excluded. This is a scenario based on current inputs, not a guarantee.

delay-housing.title: Change housing payment timing
delay-housing.tradeoff: Only the cash payment date changes. House prices, loans, rent, and child arrangements are not adjusted automatically.

retirement-budget.title: Compare self-funded retirement budgets
retirement-budget.tradeoff: Lower spending means a different retirement budget. Healthcare and care needs do not automatically decrease.

retire-later.title: Compare retirement dates
retire-later.tradeoff: The baseline work-income and retirement-spending boundary changes. Independently scheduled work, pensions, and events keep their own dates.

opening-cash.title: Review opening available assets
opening-cash.tradeoff: Use only existing accessible funds, not expected future earnings or property valuations.

simulation.description: Changes are made to a copy, not your saved plan.
simulation.stale: Your plan has changed. This comparison is out of date; close and reopen it.
simulation.error: This change cannot be calculated. Check amounts, dates, and conflicts with existing periods.
simulation.exclusions: Unentered expenses, policy changes, and uncertain future events are excluded. Returns are not guaranteed.

evidence.title: Calculation basis
evidence.description: Review inputs, assumptions, and monthly calculation records.
evidence.basis: Today's purchasing power. Growth and returns are real rates; inflation is not added again. Non-cash assets do not automatically cover cash shortfalls.
evidence.no_records: No separate records for this month.

housing.intro: Estimate the deposit and repayments before adding them. Do not duplicate mortgage or rent already in your monthly spending.
housing.deposit_deducted: The deposit is deducted from available cash in the purchase month.
housing.cash_after_hint: The end-of-month amount also includes every other income and expense in that month.
housing.cash_gap: Available funds fall below zero after the deposit and the month's other cash flows are included.
housing.explanation: Equal monthly repayments use the quoted annual rate divided by 12. The final payment settles the remaining balance. The deposit is deducted directly from existing available cash in the purchase month, when repayments also begin; property and debt enter net worth then, without adding the loan as spendable income. Price, deposit and repayments are held in today’s money without additional inflation. Add taxes, renovation, maintenance and rent separately. Not a bank quote.
housing.remove_confirm: Remove this purchase, its deposit, property and mortgage? Other cash flows will remain.
housing.error: Check price, deposit, rate and date. Deposit cannot exceed the price; rate must be 0–30% and term 1–40 whole years.

relocation.events_entry: Plan a move to another city
relocation.events_hint: Open housing planning to record the destination, timing, and amount changes.
relocation.manual_title: Record the move, then confirm the amounts
relocation.manual_hint: Cities label your life plan only. They do not automatically change property prices, salary, or living costs. Enter only the changes caused by the move.
relocation.once_hint: Included in the move month only. Use 0 if none.
relocation.change_hint: Positive increases spending; negative reduces it.
relocation.income_hint: Positive increases income; negative reduces it.
relocation.zero_hint: Use 0 where nothing changes. All amounts use today’s purchasing power.
relocation.error: Enter a destination and valid move month. Amounts must be within ±CNY 1 billion, and moving cost cannot be negative.

timeline.title: Life timeline
timeline.empty: Add a home purchase, child milestone, or another one-time life event to see it here chronologically.

stages.title: Spending by life stage
stages.hint: Key events divide the plan into stages so you can compare average spending, its main destination, and each stage total.
